name: Donchian Breakout Momentum — NVDA
description: Long-only breakout momentum strategy on NVDA using Donchian Channels. Entry when close breaks above the prior bar's 20-day highest high; exit when close breaks below the prior bar's 10-day lowest low. Fully invested (100% equity) per trade.
source:
# Donchian Breakout Momentum — NVDA
# =============================================================================
# Long-only breakout momentum strategy on NVDA using Donchian Channels.
#
# RULES:
# - Entry: Close > Prior bar's 20-day Donchian Upper Band (highest high)
# - Exit:  Close < Prior bar's 10-day Donchian Lower Band (lowest low)
# - Sizing: 100% of equity per trade (fully invested)
# - Long-only strategy
# =============================================================================

# =============================================================================
# DATA SOURCE
# =============================================================================
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c

# =============================================================================
# INDICATORS
# =============================================================================

high = src.h
low = src.l

# 20-Day Donchian Channel for entry (highest high over 20 bars)
donchian_entry = donchian_channel(window=20)(high)
upper_band = donchian_entry.bbands_upper

# 10-Day Donchian Channel for exit (lowest low over 10 bars)
donchian_exit = donchian_channel(window=10)(low)
lower_band = donchian_exit.bbands_lower

# Lag bands by 1 bar to avoid look-ahead bias
# Today's high/low contributes to today's channel — compare against PRIOR bar
upper_band_prior = upper_band >> 1
lower_band_prior = lower_band >> 1

# =============================================================================
# ENTRY / EXIT SIGNALS
# =============================================================================

# ENTRY: Close breaks above prior bar's 20-day high (new breakout)
entry_signal = close > upper_band_prior

# EXIT: Close breaks below prior bar's 10-day low
exit_signal = close < lower_band_prior

# Hold position from entry until exit fires
held = hold_until()(enter=entry_signal, exit=exit_signal)

# =============================================================================
# EXECUTION
# =============================================================================

# Long-only zone
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held)

# Fully invested: 100% of equity per trade
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=100)

# =============================================================================
# EVENT MARKERS
# =============================================================================

# Mark breakout entries
event_marker(schema=EventMarkerSchema(
    title="Donchian Breakout Entry",
    icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
    schemas=[
        ColumnSpec(title="Close", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title="Breakout Level", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title="Signal", type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
    ]
))(close, upper_band_prior, entry_signal)

# Mark exits (10-day low breakdown)
event_marker(schema=EventMarkerSchema(
    title="10-Day Low Breakdown Exit",
    icon=Icon.TrendingDownIcon,
    schemas=[
        ColumnSpec(title="Close", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title="Breakdown Level", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title="Signal", type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
    ]
))(close, lower_band_prior, exit_signal)
